name: scroll-text
title: Scroll Text
description: A statement that the reader brings into focus by scrolling: its words go from the muted text colour to the full one, in reading order, as the paragraph moves up the screen. For one large sentence a page is built around (a mission, a finding, a promise)…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/scroll-text

Installed to `components/ui/effects/scroll-text.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/scroll-text';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/scroll-text

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
